instruction: Open the hotel booking page through the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United homepage to the hotel booking page. Evaluator verifies URL contains both 'united.com' and 'hotel' patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirements: URL must contain both 'united.com' (verifying United Airlines website) and 'hotel' (verifying hotel booking page)
Getter function (get_active_url_from_accessTree -> active_tab_info) can successfully extract the active tab's URL from the accessibility tree
Metric function (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly implements AND logic: iterates through all patterns and returns 0.0 if any pattern is missing, 1.0 only if all patterns match
Expected values are semantically correct: ['united.com', 'hotel'] accurately represent the two requirements in the instruction
Complete coverage: both aspects of the instruction are verified (correct website + correct page type)
Proper data flow: result can be either string URL or dict with 'url' field, metric handles both formats correctly
No state timing issues: URL is read from active browser state, no need for postconfig
